entries.headline: UKMTO vessel-strike warning relayed
entries.summary: War Watch reported that the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations centre issued a warning after a vessel master said the vessel had been struck. The visible post text is truncated before identifying what struck it.

entries.headline: Zaporizhzhia school-strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Meduza report that Ukraine's president said Russian bombs struck a school used to distribute humanitarian aid in Zaporizhzhia. It said the report preceded wire coverage by five minutes and was confirmed by two outlets.

entries.headline: Iran deal-guarantor report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Iran Observer statement that Iran wanted Russia and China to be guarantors of a deal with the United States.

entries.headline: U.S. bomber, surveillance and radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. bombers and surveillance aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside unusual coded radio traffic, with Baltic-region air activity at nearly three times normal levels.

entries.headline: Washington manhole-smoke response reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that D.C. Fire and EMS responded to smoke from multiple manholes and that there was a large police presence outside the World Bank. The visible post text is truncated after that point.

entries.headline: AF2 C-32A sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-32A registration 99-0003, call sign AF2 and hex ADFEB9. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: U.S. Patriot missile sale report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Military Times report that the United States approved a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine.

entries.headline: Iran–Russia Middle East war discussion report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Insider Paper report, attributed to state media and credited to @reagan0965, that Iran's security chief discussed the Middle East war with the Russian president.

entries.headline: Wizz Air diversion report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Sky News report that a Wizz Air flight from London to Bulgaria was diverted to Budapest after a reported bomb threat. It said the report preceded wire coverage by 31 minutes and was later confirmed by two outlets.

entries.headline: Baghdad British Embassy incident report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an initial Tasnim report, credited to @weslester6474, of an explosion and gunfire at the British Embassy in Baghdad, Iraq.

entries.headline: AF2 Boeing C-32A sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-32A registration 99-0003, call sign AF2 and hex ADFEB9, heading north out of Washington, D.C. The sighting was credited to jessidavin.

entries.headline: Korea and Japan activity above normal reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and activity near Korea and Japan at nearly three times normal levels.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NetJets and Flexjet activity growth reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracked NetJets and Flexjet activity up 11.0% in October 2026 from October 2025, while full-service Jet A rose from $7.50 to $7.86. It said fractional flying did not slow and that the figures were pulled with the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: N722BD Learjet 60 crash reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Learjet 60 N722BD, flying from Austin to North Eleuthera, crashed near Military Trail in Palm Beach County on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people aboard. It said the NTSB was investigating and shared an AVIAR Labs Overwatch replay.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.
